findings.evidenceJa: 貴方程度の[ruby text=ちから char=2]存在
findings.governingReading: an existence of your meager level
findings.explanation: Caster disparages Shirou’s level of existence; the English reduces this to quantity of power.

findings.governingReading: a world with neither up nor down
findings.explanation: The space’s specific loss of vertical orientation is generalized.

findings.highlight: I don’t hear the sound of its swing
findings.governingReading: there is not even the sound of cutting through empty air
findings.explanation: The absent aerodynamic sound becomes a generic weapon-swing sound.

findings.highlight: rip off those annoying limbs of yours
findings.explanation: mirror moon inserts an explicit limb-ripping threat before also translating the source pruning image.

findings.highlight: even though I have your mind
findings.governingReading: even though I have suppressed your head
findings.explanation: Caster’s bodily or neurological control is changed into possession of Shirou’s mind.

findings.evidenceJa: 大事に大事に扱ってあげる
findings.governingReading: I will take very, very good care of you
findings.explanation: Caster’s possessive, repeated mock-tenderness loses its sinister emphasis.

findings.highlight: The nausea that almost causes me to throw up my organs
findings.evidenceJa: 口から内臓全てを吐き出しかねない回転
findings.governingReading: the rotation that threatened to make me vomit out every organ
findings.explanation: A physically impossible rotation of the organs is reduced to nausea.
